CONSTAN...TINVS AVG ; DN CONSTANTINI MAX AVG

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of the house of Constantine, AD 335 - AD 337 (Reece period 17). The coin is slightly worn with the focus of damage present around the exterior edges. Obverse: Clean-shaven, a youthful male, facing right, with a laureate crown with tails behind the head. Inscription: 'CONSTAN...TINVS AVG'.
